scope: Read-only visual inventory of all95 supplied Diamond/Pearl PNG sheets, mapped to canonical Platinum move IDs1..467. Analysis artifact only; no asset changes, game-code changes, builds, tests or emulator runs.
matching_policy: Direct named matches mean filename/caption identity, not completed integration or a unique finished animation.
Normalized matching removes punctuation, spaces and case. Typographical aliases, presentation/direction suffixes and combined names are recorded explicitly.
Usable-looking means visible isolated sprite/particle/component art exists. It still requires frame extraction, alpha/palette/layout work and choreography/timing verification.
Background-only sheets count as named source components, not dedicated actor/projectile sprites.
Generic/component candidates are separate from direct matches, carry explicit confidence, and do not count as dedicated source coverage.
No timing metadata was supplied for the95 PNGs. Original move ownership and complete animation fidelity were not verified against native scripts.
A missing external exact match does not mean new art must be found: the complete native Platinum source/assets provide an additional extraction route.
Current runtime dispatch is a separate axis: every one of the467 canonical moves already has a runtime assignment in vfx-showcase/runtime-map.json, frequently using shared/fallback art.
